source_transition_scaling.derivation: Let dz=L/N, w=OAFTRANSITION[0], offset=OAFTRANSITION[1]. Source p=(w,offset)/dz and logistic argument p0*(node-onset-p1) imply logit a=w*(z-z_onset-offset)/dz^2, with AFFNC=1/(1+exp(-a)). For positive w, characteristic physical transition length is dz^2/w; doubling N divides it by four.
